Priya Nair: FYI — pricebook v2 (internal) will replace the current pricebook on Mon 2026-05-18 09:00 PT. Need quick sync re: special discounts and grandfathering.

Priya Nair: TL;DR asks: 1) approval threshold for ad-hoc discounts >25% 2) mapping for commit tiers -> SKU bundles 3) legacy SKU grandfathering window

Evan Carter: +1. For (1) do we want Deal Desk or Sales Ops to auto-approve up to 35% for sandbox/edu trials?

DealDeskBot: Ticket created: DD-4532 — subject: pricebook-v2 ad-hoc discount policy. Assigned: @Evan Carter, @Lena Park

Lena Park: Proposal below — please react with :thumbsup: to accept or :eyes: for questions.

Lena Park: ```
# discount_policy.csv
min_commit_usd,max_commit_usd,max_discount
0,9999,20%
10000,49999,30%
50000,99999,35%
100000,inf,40%
# exceptions: Education/Research flagged separately, cap 50% with Deal Desk approval
```

Samir Gupta: APAC question — do tiers apply to multi-region deals? Need note for cloud egress pricing.

Priya Nair: Good catch. Add a footnote: tiers are global commit, but region add-ons billed separately. I'll ask infra to add region SKU flag.

Evan Carter: For the one-off healthtech POC in EMEA, I'd propose 40% max discount one quarter only, with cap $15k. @Lena, can you sign off?

Lena Park: I can sign off on that one-off if legal ok with data residency clause. Put the exact wording in DD-4532.

Priya Nair: OK — final ask: react +1 by EOD Fri. If no objections, I'll kick the rollout Monday and route exceptions to Deal Desk queue DD-4532. :rocket:

DealDeskBot: DD-4532 updated: status=Awaiting signoff; watchers=[Priya Nair, Evan Carter, Lena Park]
